summary: Security Features Testing Complete - 12/12 backend tests passed. All security features working correctly: Rate limiting (50/day, 20/hour, 5/min), Audit trail with hash chain, Admin action logging, Cryptographic randomness for draws, and ticket system (1 scan = 1 entry to permanent ticket).

integration_issues.issue: Login form fills correctly but session doesn't persist after clicking Login button on web. URL changes from /(auth)/login to /login but stays on login page. Backend login API works fine via curl.

backend: Rate limit remaining calculation correct (daily_limit - daily_scans)
POST /api/scan - Returns ticket_number, entries_added, total_entries, multiplier
Ticket number stays same across multiple scans (TXA-H1WYDS format)
GET /api/tickets/my-tickets - Returns ticket_number and entries count correctly
Rate limit counters update after scan
frontend: My Tickets page (tickets.tsx) correctly structured with ticket_number and entries display
Expanded view shows 'Your Ticket Number' with TXA-XXXXXX format
Expanded view shows 'X entries in the draw' text
Stats banner shows 'Total Entries' and 'Active Draws' counts

action_items: OPTIONAL: Investigate web login session persistence issue - Login form works but auth state doesn't persist in browser session. This may be a web-specific issue with Expo/React Native web storage.
critical_code_review_comments: security_service.py correctly implements: CryptoRandom (secrets.SystemRandom), AuditTrail (hash chain), ScanRateLimiter (50/20/5), AdminAuditLog
add_entries_to_ticket() function correctly calls scan_rate_limiter and audit_trail
execute_draw() correctly uses crypto_random.select_winners() and logs admin actions
Frontend tickets.tsx correctly displays ticket_number and entries from API response
seed_data_creation: Test scans created during testing incremented user's entries. Current state: ticket TXA-H1WYDS with 7 entries.
